brief:
Israeli occupation forces demolished a residential home in the Deirat area east of Yatta, the Ma'an news agency reported. The demolition destroyed a structure in the southern West Bank town, adding to a pattern of house destructions in Palestinian areas.

Yatta lies in the Hebron governorate, a region that has experienced repeated Israeli demolitions of Palestinian-owned structures, often cited by Israeli authorities as lacking permits in areas under military control.
title: Israeli forces demolish home east of Yatta city
